title: Regional Blocks of Gynecological Surgeries
brief_summary: This study will be conducted on 273 patients of ASA grade I and II aged from 25 to 55 years and presented for elective vaginal surgeries such as vaginal hysterectomy, repair of prolapse Patients will be divided into three equal groups; group A control group for conventional epidural technique(n=91), group B for dural puncture epidural with 27G pencil point Whitacre spinal needle (n=91) and group C for dural puncture epidural with 25G pencil point Whitacre spinal needle(n=91). Randomization will be done using computer generated number and concealed using sequentially numbered sealed opaque envelope.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA I and II
* Height(150-170 cm)

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient refusal
* hypersensitivity to local anesthetic drugs
* bleeding disorders and coagulopathy(platelets count less than 80000,INR less than 1.5 or therapeutic dose of anticoagulant).
condition: Gynecologic Disease Requiring Vaginal Operation Under Neuraxial Anesthesia
